text:
devin_partnerships: Quick heads-up — RackCloud proposed a bundled HW+cloud offering with our open model inside their marketplace. Legal spotted a clause that looks like it allows their downstream redistributors to repackage the model weights. Need opinions before we proceed.

sophie_legal: Can you paste the clause? High level: are they claiming sublicense rights or just distribution under our license?

devin_partnerships: Here's the snippet from the draft contract:

```text
Section 4.2: "Partner may sublicense, redistribute, and integrate the Model into Partner Products and Services, including third-party resellers and marketplaces, without further consent from Licensor."
```

jenna_hw: :eyes: That reads like broad sublicensing. On HW side we wanted limited redistribution for certified systems only.

chris_cloud: That's risky — our open models are under permissive licenses but the marketplace bundle would imply commercial redistribution. We need to ensure attribution + no implicit transfer of support obligations.

maria_pm: Also product concern: if partners can rebrand and resell with different quantization, we could get inconsistent performance reports back to customers.

sophie_legal: Recommend changing clause to: "Partner may distribute binaries for specified certified products only; sublicensing to third parties requires prior written approval and must preserve license terms." I'll draft redline.

aj_infra: From infra perspective, if they redistribute modified binaries we lose ability to enforce KV cache telemetry and tracing hooks for support. We should add a clause that prohibits circumventing telemetry and requires integrity metadata.

compliance-bot: FYI — export control check: model exceeds EAR99? Please confirm model training data sources and any U.S.-origin restricted components.

devin_partnerships: Thanks — I'll collect training provenance details for compliance. Sophie — can you drop the redline into the shared drive? Link here: https://drive.redwood.internal/rackcloud/draft-v2

sophie_legal: Dropped. Please review: https://drive.redwood.internal/rackcloud/draft-v2#redlines

jenna_hw: Added a hardware certification appendix comment — we only allow distribution of shard files tied to certified HW images.

chris_cloud: Suggest adding a rollback/fallback in case partner's marketplace listing introduces a degraded model variant: automatic routing back to our hosted model for customers with enterprise SLA.

maria_pm: Agreed. Also let's include a short FAQ for GTM to avoid mixed messaging with partner marketing.

devin_partnerships: Plan: (1) legal redline + compliance vetting by EOD tomorrow, (2) 30-min sync Wed 10am PT to finalize, (3) if green, include addendum for certified redistribution and telemetry. Who's in?

sophie_legal: In.

jenna_hw: In.

chris_cloud: In.

aj_infra: Might be late but can join first 15m.

maria_pm: In.

devin_partnerships: Cool — I'll send calendar invite and attach redline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sophie_legal: Also cc: security & privacy for data handling review once we confirm redistribution scope.

devin_partnerships: Done — added @security and @privacy to the invite.

chris_cloud: One more ask: add a clause that any partner analytics using our telemetry must never send PII. We'll ask privacy to validate.

sophie_legal: Noted. Will include language about pseudonymization and prohibited data flows.

devin_partnerships: Last note — if RackCloud insists on broad sublicensing, we should consider a carve-out: allow marketplace listing only if they act as a reseller (no rebranding / no sublicensing). We'll discuss Wed.

maria_pm: Sounds good. Meeting invite incoming.

jenna_hw: Thanks, team.

compliance-bot: Reminder: save the final redline to the contracts repo with tag `rackcloud-v2` for audit.

devin_partnerships: Will do. Closing thread until sync.
